name: Tea-Brewed Oatmeal
desc: Rolled oats simmered in strong chai rooibos tea with almond butter, manuka honey and wild blueberries.

source.title: Tea-Brewed Oatmeal
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup wild blueberries (frozen and thawed, or fresh)

steps: Bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan, remove from the heat, add the tea bags and steep 5 minutes. Squeeze out and discard the bags.
Stir the oats and salt into the tea. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, 2 to 5 minutes until thick and creamy.
Take off the heat and let stand 1 minute. Stir in the almond butter and honey.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the blueberries.
tips: The tea flavor comes through strongly, so use a tea you would happily drink on its own.

references.title: How to Make Oatmeal
references.usedFor: 1 cup liquid to 1/2 cup rolled oats, pinch of salt, cook time and 1-minute stand

references.title: Tea Oatmeal Recipe
